description: First LIF (spiking) policy in the walker2d-lut programme: a LIF-detector LUT ACTOR (LIFMultiHeadLUT, universal-timing always-on) paired with the exp19-style MLP exponential-head critic. Latency-coded input -> LIF first-spike bucketing -> mixed-radix table gather, addresses learned via straight-through; tables combined by the sum-scaled log-sum-exp (exp_outputs). Critic is exp19's exact exp-MLP head (tau_c init 0.25). PPO bench7 stabilization recipe, same hyperparams as the exp13-15/exp15b LUT sweeps for comparability.
actor: LIFMultiHeadLUT (n_heads=1, tables_per_head=32, n_det=1, n_buckets=64, freeze_temperature=False, exp_outputs=True, scale=sum)
critic: exp19-style MLP exponential head ([256,256] Tanh, orthogonal gain 1.0, centred sum-scaled LSE readout, tau_c init 0.25)
